about: Every value below was read off a published Yaskawa document and carries the document id and the page it was read on. Nothing here is modelled, derived or guessed; a number without a page citation does not belong in this file. The GP7 shares both documents with the GP8, so each value states which column or table it came from.

DS-699-H.title: GP7 and GP8 Robots - Compact, High-Speed Robots
DS-699-H.publisher: Yaskawa America, Inc. - Motoman Robotics Division
DS-699-H.read_note: One datasheet covers both robots in two columns. Every value taken from it here is the GP8 column; the GP7 column is deliberately ignored.

HW1484385.title: MOTOMAN-GP8, -GP7 Supplemental Instructions
HW1484385.read_note: Table 5-1 Basic Specifications (GP8) is on page 4, Table 3-3 Ambient Conditions on page 3. The manual documents type YR-1-06VX8-F00 (food-grade grease) and states that it differs from the standard YR-1-06VX8-A00 (manual HW1483944) in grease, application, location, basic specifications, inspection schedule and recommended spare parts.

payload.note: Wrist payload. The manual repeats it on page 4 as Payload / Wrist part 8 kg.

payload_u_arm.note: The allowable U-arm load varies with the wrist load; the manual refers to chapter 7.1.1.

horizontal_reach.note: The dimension drawing on the same page prints it as R727.

repeatability.note: Page 1 of the same datasheet repeats +/-0.02 mm repeatability for the GP8.

repeatability_manual.note: Conformed to ISO 9283. This disagrees with DS-699-H, which prints +/-0.02 mm; both values are kept with their own citation rather than averaged.

mass.note: GP8 column. The GP7 column on the same row reads 34 kg; this project used that GP7 figure as the GP8 mass until the datasheet was read, and cpp_solver/include/study/gp8_model.hpp now carries the 32 kg GP8 value.

mass_manual.note: Approximate mass of type YR-1-06VX8-F00. Disagrees with the 32 kg of DS-699-H.

noise.note: Equivalent continuous A-weighted sound pressure level to ISO 11201, at maximum load and maximum speed.

power_capacity.note: The manual prints the same 1 kVA on page 4 as Power Capacity.

source.table: SPECIFICATIONS, row Internal user I/O cable

internal_user_io_conductors.note: 17 conductors plus ground, through connector LF13WBRB-20S / LF13WBRB-20P.

source.table: SPECIFICATIONS, row Internal user air line

internal_user_air_lines.note: Two 1/4 inch connections, tapped Rc1/4 with pipe plug.

body_xp_package.note: Optional eXtra Protection package. Page 2 warns that specifications for the XP package may differ.

enclosure_manual.note: The manual states IP67 for the whole manipulator, where the datasheet splits IP67 wrist from IP54 body.

options.note: The manual adds on page 4 that the S-axis operating range is limited for the tilt- and wall-mounted cases.

known_disagreements: Robot mass: DS-699-H page 2 prints 32 kg for the GP8 and 34 kg for the GP7; HW1484385 page 4 prints 35 kg for the GP8 food-grade type. cpp_solver/include/study/gp8_model.hpp uses 34 kg, which is the GP7 datasheet figure.
Repeatability: DS-699-H page 2 prints +/-0.02 mm; HW1484385 page 4 prints 0.01 mm to ISO 9283.
L-axis upper limit: DS-699-H page 2 prints +150 deg for the GP8; HW1484385 page 4 prints +145 deg. GP8_JOINT_LIMITS holds 2.530 rad = 144.96 deg, i.e. the manual.
U-axis range: DS-699-H page 2 prints +255/-113 deg for the GP8; HW1484385 page 4 prints -70 to +190 deg. GP8_JOINT_LIMITS holds -1.221 to 3.316 rad = -69.96 to 190.0 deg, i.e. the manual.
S-axis maximum speed: both documents say 455 deg/s = 7.94 rad/s, but GP8_JOINT_LIMITS stores 7.85 rad/s = 449.8 deg/s, 1.1 percent low.
Protection: DS-699-H page 1 splits IP67 wrist from IP54 body (IP65 with the XP package); HW1484385 page 4 states IP67 for the protective enclosure.
